config.title: Alessandro Bonatti
config.description: I am a full stack developer actively searching for a job in Sweden, Malmö

intro: a Full Stack Web Developer with over 25 years of experience in the field.
I started my career in 1999 as an employee, a role I held for 13 years, before transitioning to freelancing and founding my own agency, which I successfully managed for another 13 years.

Through this journey, I have gained extensive experience in web development, working with various technologies and tackling projects of varying complexity. My expertise ranges from front end to back end development, with a strong focus on creating scalable, maintainable, and high-performance solutions.

Since relocating to Malmö, Sweden in October 2025, I have been working as a software development consultant, gaining valuable experience within the Swedish professional environment.

This experience has broadened my perspective on collaboration, communication, and modern software development practices, while allowing me to further develop my technical skills and adapt to a new professional culture.
footer: Born on 17/01/1976, I am an independent person with years of experience and a strong determination to constantly challenge myself. I approach every new challenge with enthusiasm and a desire to grow, always open to new learning and improvement opportunities.

I have a driving license for both cars and motorcycles and am used to managing myself autonomously and adapting to different environments. I look forward to relocate to Scandinavia to embark on new professional and personal experiences, bringing with me my initiative, reliability, and eagerness to actively contribute to new projects.

I’m embarking on this exciting new chapter of life with my partner — both in love and work — Carmen. She’s the most talented developer I know. Take a look at her work!

skills.title: Web Backend — API
skills.description: I started my professional career as a .NET developer in a Microsoft environment, then, within a few years, I transitioned to the open source world and philosophy. Over the years, I became passionate about modern development frameworks and technologies, and today my primary focus is on Typescript and Node.js, with Fastify for backend development. I also have extensive experience with the PHP/Laravel ecosystem, which has been an important part of my professional journey for several years.

skills.title: Web Frontend
skills.description: In recent years, I have sought to bridge the gaps that separated me from becoming a complete and independent developer as much as possible by deepening my knowledge of Frontend development and Typescript, particularly the Vue.js and React frameworks alongside Tailwind CSS. I have experience with SEO-related issues, as well as usability and accessibility.

skills.title: Server & Tools
skills.description: I can configure a scalable Linux web server based on PHP and MySQL, including a backup system. I have developed and used various types of APIs. I can work independently, but I am also accustomed to working in teams of various sizes. I have built my own CMS from scratch, which I use as the foundation for most of my projects.

passions.text: The mountains and forests are my refuge, places where I can find balance between nature and freedom. I love experiencing the mountains in every possible way, from trekking to mountain biking, from skiing to climbing. I adore snow, fog, and cold climates; and I already know that the thing I will miss the most when I’m in Sweden will be the Alps.

I have also been passionate about video games and role-playing games, both digital and tabletop, since I was a child. I believe they help stimulate creativity, critical thinking, and teamwork. I enjoy TV series, cinema, and nerd culture in general.

I’m a passionate traveler drawn to both the Far East and the Far North — fascinated by Japan’s culture and philosophy as well as Scandinavia’s minimalism, nature, and innovation. Traveling helps me grow, learn, and experience the world through different lenses.
